FS013传说级暗黑魔龙
“暗灵箭！”
“噬灵箭！”
“毒灵箭！”
三声轻喝，三支带着黑色光芒的箭矢，成品字形射向文森。
文森头也不转，法杖一挥，轻喝一声，“障碍！”
那三支箭矢，在虚空之中仿佛被无形的手拉住，速度缓缓降低。最后停在文森身前。文森抬起法杖底端，将三支箭矢敲落在地，然后转头往箭矢射来方向看去。
“咦？”
在那边，居然有一个和被束缚住的暗黑精灵少女一模一样的少女！
“坏蛋，放开我妹妹！”少女举起手中的弓箭，拉开弓弦，寒光闪烁的箭矢指向文森。
“你们是谁？”文森笑呵呵的解除了空间魔法束缚。
束缚解除之后，少女怯怯的看了文森一眼，随后如同受惊的小鹿一般，跑到另一名少女身后，然后对着文森吐了吐舌头。
“尊贵的人类法师，您好！我们是暗黑精灵族的公主，我叫克丽丝，这是我的妹妹爱丽丝。”克丽丝学着人类的礼仪，向文森行了一礼。
“噢？你们居然是暗黑精灵族的公主？”文森转头看向已经回来的克索斯，问道：“克索斯管家，你不是说暗黑精灵族一般生活在地下吗？怎么她们都跑上来了？”
克索斯尴尬的笑了笑，“这个，这个，文森少爷，我也不知道。”
“尊贵的人类法师，您这个问题我可以回答您。我们本来生活在地下，可是前一段时间，我们生活的区域来了一只暗黑魔龙。这只暗黑魔龙扰乱了我们平静的生活，于是我们暂时到了地面躲避它。”克丽丝解答道。
文森眼神一亮，“暗黑魔龙？”
疾风贪狼给了阿莱格拉，文森早就想再抓一只魔宠、坐骑、保镖、小弟兼恶仆，只不过荒野平原上，居然没有遇见任何超过五级以上的魔兽。
现在听见暗黑魔龙，他心中顿时有了想法。
虽然没有契约之光，不过他有神话级远古炎龙的血液，只要打得过暗黑魔龙，就能强制签订主仆契约！

“什么等级的暗黑魔龙？”文森问道。
“上位传说级！”克丽丝带着一丝恐惧道。
这个等级的魔兽，威能强横，想要毁灭没有同等级强者坐镇的小种族，简直是轻而易举！
“太好了！”文森欢呼一声。
疾风贪狼虽然是传说级魔兽，不过它仅仅是初位，而且还是初位中不起眼那种。而暗黑魔龙却是上位传说级！
并且，暗黑魔龙还有成长空间，说不定什么时候就进阶圣灵级，说不定还能成长为神话级！
“克丽丝，那个暗黑魔龙，还在吗？”
克丽丝疑惑的看着他，虽然文森是空间魔法师，天赋属性很厉害，但是他的实力，绝对没有达到史诗级，更别说传说级！
‘难道他想去打败暗黑魔龙，做传说中的屠龙勇士？’克丽丝心中暗自想到。
“尊贵的人类法师，很感激您能放了我的妹妹。所以，我很真诚的希望您打消做屠龙勇士的念头。那可是一头上位传说级的暗黑魔龙，您的实力，应该比它要差一点点。”克丽丝委婉的劝道。
“谢谢关心，不过我还是想去看看那头暗黑魔龙。”文森坚持道。
站在他身后的克索斯，有意无意的放出一丝史诗级法师威压。顿时，克丽丝、爱丽丝两人朝他看去。
‘好恐怖的魔力！’克丽丝心中暗道。‘不过，这个老者也不是那头暗黑魔龙的对手！算了算了，就让他下去看看吧。反正与我们没有关系！’
打定主意之后，克丽丝指着西方道：“尊贵的人类法师，您一直往西方走去，就会发现一片荒凉的山脉。那片山脉底下，您仔细找一找，便能找到一个进入地底的入口。进去之后，您就会发现那头暗黑魔龙的。我想，它现在应该在沉睡。”
“西方？倒是顺路！”文森取出一颗黑暗属性的四阶魔核，抛向克丽丝道：“谢谢你的消息，小精灵。”
说完之后，他身上青光一闪，人影已经朝着西方赶去。
克丽丝拿着魔核有些发愣，远远地，一道声音传来。“对了，爱丽丝，下次等你来吃我哦！哈哈哈哈~~~~”
爱丽丝看着文森远去的背影，张牙舞爪道：“可恶的人类！”
克丽丝无奈的抚摸着爱丽丝的黑发，劝道：“妹妹，那个人类法师并不坏，要不然你就危险了！赶紧跟我回去，以后不准一个人出来！要是再敢乱跑，就把你锁起来！”
“知道了，姐姐。”爱丽丝可怜兮兮道。

利用风系魔法的加持，文森和克索斯两人的速度至少达到每小时六十飞轮。饶是如此，两人也赶了差不多五小时，才站在一片荒凉的山脉前。
这片山脉果然如同克索斯形容的一般，荒凉得啥都没有。延绵的山脉，除了长有一些低矮的灌木丛，其他的什么都没有。
这样的山脉，即使有魔药，那也不是什么好东西！
文森站在山脉脚下，闭上眼睛，感受着这里的气息。空气中弥漫着一股厚重的泥土味，还有一股淡淡的黑暗气息。
“文森少爷，我们真的要在这样荒凉的地方建立领地？”克索斯再次想要劝阻文森，即使要建立领地，也不用再这样荒凉得地方建立啊。
克伦蒂亚世界，土地多着呢！
“这里挺好的！”文森依旧闭着眼睛，脑中不断闪烁着矿物辨别和魔法材料辨别的知识，他总感觉前方的山体十分奇怪。
一股隐晦的魔力波动从山体中传出，不过其中受到什么阻挡，导致这股魔力波动异常的微弱，且时隐时现。
如果不是他拥有矿物辨别、魔法材料辨别神匠级职业，他也休想发现！
“文森少爷，这里什么都没有，我们以后怎么发展呢？”
“是吗？克索斯管家，或许所有人都错了，这里是个好地方！”文森终于知道那山体中到底是什么了，同时也知道了什么东西阻挡了魔力波动！
“当真是天助我也！”文森哈哈大笑起来。
克索斯虽然不明白文森在笑什么，不过经历了神话卷轴击退神话强者后，克索斯对文森的信心越来越足。
既然文森说这里是好地方，那他克索斯跟着走就是了。
“克索斯管家，明天我们再去收拾那个暗黑魔龙，今天晚上我要好好想想怎么发展领地，你去抓点吃的回来。”
“好的，文森少爷稍等。”

content_en:
FS013 Legendary Dark Dragon
"Dark Spirit Arrow!"
"Soul-Eating Arrow!"
"Poison Spirit Arrow!"
After three soft shouts, three arrows with black light shot towards Vincent in the shape of a perfect glyph.
Without turning his head, Vincent waved his staff and shouted softly, "Obstacle!"
The three arrows seemed to be held by invisible hands in the void, and their speed slowly decreased. Finally stopped in front of Vincent. Vincent raised the bottom of the staff, knocked the three arrows to the ground, and then turned to look in the direction in which the arrows were shot.
"Huh?"
Over there, there is a girl who looks exactly like the restrained dark elf girl!
"Bad guy, let go of my sister!" The girl raised the bow and arrow in her hand, unstretched the bowstring, and pointed the cold arrow at Vincent.
"Who are you?" Vincent laughed and released the space magic restraint.
After the restraints were lifted, the girl glanced at Vincent timidly, then ran behind the other girl like a frightened deer, and then stuck out her tongue at Vincent.
"Hello, distinguished human mage! We are the princesses of the dark elves. My name is Chris, and this is my sister Alice." Chris learned human etiquette and bowed to Vincent.
"Oh? You are actually the princesses of the dark elves?" Vincent turned to look at Xosos, who had returned, and asked: "Steward Xos, didn't you say that the dark elves generally live underground? Why are they all running up here?"
Xosos smiled awkwardly, "This, this, Master Vincent, I don't know either."
"Dear human mage, I can answer your question. We originally lived underground, but some time ago, a dark dragon came to the area where we lived. This dark dragon disturbed our peaceful life, so we temporarily went to the ground to avoid it." Chris answered.
Vincent's eyes lit up, "Dark Demon Dragon?"
The Gale Greedy Wolf was given to Allegra, and Vincent had long wanted to capture another demon pet, mount, bodyguard, younger brother and evil servant. However, he did not encounter any magical beasts above level five on the wilderness plain.
Now that he heard the Dark Demonic Dragon, he suddenly had an idea in his mind.
Although he does not have the light of contract, he has the blood of the mythical ancient flame dragon. As long as he can defeat the dark dragon, he can forcefully sign a master-servant contract!
"What level is the dark dragon?" Vincent asked.
"Legendary level!" Chris said with a hint of fear.
Warcraft of this level are so powerful that it is easy to destroy a small race that does not have a strong person of the same level!
"Great!" Vincent cheered.
Although the Gale Greedy Wolf is a legendary monster, it is only in the first rank, and it is still an inconspicuous one among the first rank. But the Dark Demon Dragon is at the upper legendary level!
Moreover, the Dark Demonic Dragon still has room for growth. He may advance to the Holy Spirit level at some point, and he may even grow to the Mythical level!
"Chris, is that dark dragon still there?"
Chrissy looked at him doubtfully. Although Vincent was a space magician with very powerful talents and attributes, his strength definitely did not reach the epic level, let alone the legendary level!
‘Does he want to defeat the dark dragon and become a legendary dragon-slaying warrior? ’ Chrissy thought to herself.
"Honored human mage, I am very grateful that you can let my sister go. Therefore, I sincerely hope that you will give up the idea of ​​becoming a dragon-slaying warrior. That is a high-level legendary dark dragon, and your strength should be a little bit worse than it." Chris persuaded tactfully.
"Thank you for your concern, but I still want to see the dark dragon." Vincent insisted.
Kesos, standing behind him, intentionally or unintentionally released a hint of epic mage pressure. Suddenly, Chris and Alice looked towards him.
‘What a terrifying magic power! ' Chris secretly thought. ‘However, this old man is no match for that dark dragon! Forget it, let him go down and have a look. It has nothing to do with us anyway! ’
After making up her mind, Chris pointed to the west and said: "Distinguished human mage, if you keep going to the west, you will find a desolate mountain range. Under that mountain range, if you search carefully, you will find an entrance into the underground. After entering, you will find the dark dragon. I think it should be sleeping now."
"The West? It's on the way!" Vincent took out a fourth-level magic core with dark attributes, threw it to Chris and said: "Thank you for the news, elf."
After he finished speaking, a green light flashed on his body, and the figure was already heading towards the west.
Chris was in a daze holding the magic core, and a voice came from a distance. "By the way, Alice, wait for you to eat me next time! Hahahaha~~~~"
Alice looked at Vincent's retreating back, bared her teeth and said, "Damnable human!"
Chris helplessly stroked Alice's black hair and persuaded: "Sister, that human mage is not bad, otherwise you will be in danger! Come back with me quickly, and you are not allowed to come out alone in the future! If you dare to run around again, I will lock you up!"
"I know, sister." Alice said pitifully.
Using the blessing of wind magic, Vincent and Xosos reached a speed of at least 60 flywheels per hour. Even so, the two of them rushed for almost five hours before they stood in front of a desolate mountain range.
This mountain range is indeed as described by Kesos, so desolate that there is nothing. There is nothing in the rolling mountains except some low bushes.
Even if there is a magic potion in such a mountain range, it is not a good thing!
Vincent stood at the foot of the mountains, closed his eyes, and felt the atmosphere here. There was a thick earthy smell in the air, and a faint hint of darkness.
"Master Vincent, do we really want to establish a territory in such a desolate place?" Xosos once again wanted to dissuade Vincent. Even if we want to establish a territory, there is no need to establish it in such a desolate place.
There is a lot of land in the world of Crentia!
"It's nice here!" Vincent still closed his eyes, and the knowledge of mineral identification and magic material identification kept flashing in his mind. He always felt that the mountain in front of him was very strange.
A vague magic wave came out from the mountain, but something blocked it, causing the magic wave to be unusually weak and appear and disappear.
If he hadn't possessed the profession of mineral identification and magic material identification, he would never have discovered it!
"Master Vincent, there is nothing here. How will we develop in the future?"
"Really? Steward Xos, maybe everyone is wrong, this is a good place!" Vincent finally knew what was in the mountain, and at the same time he also knew what blocked the magic wave!
"God is really helping me!" Vincent burst out laughing.
Although Xosos didn't understand what Vincent was laughing at, after experiencing the mythical scroll defeating the mythical strongman, Xosos had more and more confidence in Vincent.
Since Vincent said this is a good place, then Taxos should just follow him.
"Butler Xos, we will deal with the dark dragon tomorrow. I will think about how to develop the territory tonight. You go and grab some food and come back."
"Okay, Master Vincent, wait a moment."
